concepts.prompt: Game pickup item concept: a small healing potion. A round-bellied glass flask with a short neck, filled with glowing teal-green healing liquid that softly glows from inside, a chunky cork stopper, and a small green leaf-shaped paper tag tied around the neck with twine. Thick chunky glass with soft highlights, flat bottom so it stands upright. About 0.32 m tall. Stylised Palworld / Animo-class game item prop, deliberately chunky and oversized, exaggerated readable silhouette that still reads clearly from 10-15 metres, soft bevelled edges, soft hand-painted PBR look, natural palette matching the Meadows key-art reference (sage and leaf greens, warm gold, cream, slate blue, teal). Single isolated object standing upright on its flat base, full object visible and centred, plain neutral light-grey background, even studio lighting, no cast shadow, no ground plane, no people, no creatures, no text, no letters, no labels, no red or crimson anywhere.
concepts.verdict: CHOSEN (view 0 only): round flask, teal-green liquid, cork, twine with leaf-printed tag; view 1 rejected for 3D because it drew the flask flat from the side (inconsistent with a round belly), so the model used single-image image-to-3d from view 0

reference_inspection: Key art inspected for palette. assets/creatures/tetherbound/potion_plant/reference/front.png inspected (mood only) and deliberately NOT sent to Meshy: its bulbs are red, which would pull the liquid toward the Team Tether reserve colour.
